summary: SiteDocument represents a link between a document and a site by their respective IDs.
purpose: The purpose is to store or represent the association between individual documents and sites within the system for retrieval or linkage.
system_behavior: SiteDocument is used to link a document to a site for data access or referencing within the system.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page/control for staff administrators, providing UI components for viewing employment applications, filtering by site and discipline, and displaying error/warning panels.
purpose: The page enables staff administrators to view and filter student employment applications, see alerts/warnings, and access last login and session information.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Page loads, initializes session and dropdown filters for site and discipline.
User selects filter parameters (site, discipline, start/end date, show withdrawn).
User clicks refresh, triggering data binding for gvwApplications.
Applications matching filters are displayed.
Error and warning panels display system or validation messages.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are flagged and can be shown/hidden.
Start date and end date must be valid, start before end.
Employment applications are filtered by site, discipline, and date.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator ensures start and end date are provided.
CustomValidator ensures start date is not after end date.
conditions: Show withdrawn flag determines if withdrawn applications are included.
Filtering by site, discipline, and dates determines which applications are shown.
system_behavior: Initializes dropdowns and filters based on session/agency.
Displays employment applications based on filters.
Displays alerts/warnings/errors for invalid input or system issues.
exceptions: Missing session cancels data source query.

summary: ServiceCode represents a coded service entry with associated category, names (including alternate languages), notes, and ordering.
purpose: To provide a list of service codes and their metadata, for use in various workflows such as course/timetable assignment or reporting.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to get all service codes for session.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID to retrieve code options for specific course or timetable.

business_rules: When UseAltLanguageFields is true in session, Name fields return alternate language values.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields determines which name field is shown (Name or NameAlt).
system_behavior: Retrieves codes using stored procedures and session data.
Returns a list of ServiceCode entries for use in other system modules.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks historical actions and changes to site profiles, including actions taken, fields changed, user and agency information, and alternate language support.
purpose: To provide audit/history tracking for site profile changes, including who performed actions, what was changed, and relevant contextual information.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: Input parameters: SiteID, SessionAgencyID, session.
Procedure returns historical entries filtered by site and agency.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, fields return their alternate language values.
AgencyUserFormatted logic includes system support team and agency/user initials.
conditions: Comparison of user IDs for display logic.
system_behavior: SiteProfileHistory entries are created/returned via stored procedures.
TooltipDetails generates contextual formatted strings about user/agency.

summary: EmailPopupDocument manages email-related document files, including searching and deletion of files associated with email popups.
purpose: Its purpose is to provide a structured way to represent documents/files related to email popups, including searching, deletion, and associating metadata.

workflows.name: Search EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Split DataInfo string by '|', then split each by '>' to retrieve file name/path.
Create EmailPopupDocument instances for each file.

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: Given DataInfo and ID, locate matching file.
Delete the file and folder, remove entry from dataInfo, return the updated string.

business_rules: If DataInfo is empty, no documents are returned.
Deletion will try to remove the file and its containing folder, ignore errors.
system_behavior: Searching creates a structured list from string data.
Deletion removes file and folder, returns updated dataInfo.
exceptions: File or folder deletion failures are caught and ignored.

summary: ExpenseBatch represents a batch of expenses, includes batch metadata, department association, dates, status, and provides methods for searching, adding, updating, and deleting batches.
purpose: To track, manage, and manipulate batches of expenses for departments, providing status, description, and operational functions for batch lifecycle.

workflows.name: Search Expense Batches
steps: Call ExpenseBatchSearch with session and department ID.
Return batches for department for the past year.

workflows.name: Add Expense Batch
steps: Call ExpenseBatchAdd with session, department ID, batch description, date.
Return batch ID.

workflows.name: Update Expense Batch
steps: Call ExpenseBatchUpdate with session, batch ID, description, date, status.
Status can be updated.

workflows.name: Delete Expense Batch
steps: Call ExpenseBatchDelete with session and batch ID.

business_rules: StatusDescription is localized if UseAltLanguageFields is true.
calculations: BatchNumberFormatted is calculated from ID and status.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields determines if alternate status description is used.
system_behavior: CRUD operations for expense batches using session and database procedures.
